description: Build the typed data core and the single Airtable boundary (design §5/§6/§8/§13): domain types, shared Zod validation schemas, the no-credential seed-data module (raster placeholders), utilities (wa.me/slugify/stat-format/env-helpers/logger), and the server-only Airtable REST DAL — client (token-bucket limiter + pagination + backoff + audience-split caching), schema/tags constants, tolerant mappers, and typed public/admin read + write functions — plus the full network-free Vitest unit + integration suite. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Read context.json FIRST (do not re-explore), then design.md §5 (Airtable schema contract), §6 (DAL), §8 (seed/empty-result rules), §13 (validation), §14 (error handling), §22 (testing). All paths under datadive-web.

src/lib/types/index.ts: camelCase domain models for Settings, Hero, About, Cta, NavLink, Service, Project (+ ProjectImage), Industry, Stat, Client, Review, TeamMember, BlogPost, ContactSubmission; image fields typed {url:string;alt:string}|null; line-parsed fields (About.points, Project.metrics) as arrays.

src/lib/validation/*.ts: shared Zod schemas per §13 — contact (name 2-100, email <=254, optional company/subject/phone, message 10-5000, honeypot 'website' must be empty, limits); per-entity admin schemas; settings (WhatsApp digits-only 7-15, email, URLs); the image-URL rule (same-origin ^/[\w\-./]+$ OR https://*.public.blob.vercel-storage.com, <=2048), the href rule ^(#anchor|/relative|https?://...)$, alt required when paired URL present, Order>=0, Rating 1-5, slug ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$. OG URL field is http(s)-only (NOT host-restricted).

src/lib/utils/*.ts: wa.me builder (digits only + optional prefill), slugify + uniqueness suffixing (-2,-3,...), stat prefix/suffix formatting, env helpers hasAirtableCreds() (AIRTABLE_API_KEY && AIRTABLE_BASE_ID) and hasAuthCreds() (AUTH_SECRET && AUTH_GOOGLE_ID && AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET), and a logger (info|warn|error) that never interpolates env secrets.

src/lib/seed/index.ts: one typed constant per content type (same domain types), derived from source-notes.md where real copy exists (brand/tagline/mission, 4 services with icon keys dashboard/bi/ai/custom, 5 industries with icon keys hr/health/retail/ops/ml, 5 primary + 4 other case studies, 5 stats 150K+/100K+/85%/42+/30+, team incl. 3rd member role 'Full-Stack & DevOps Engineer' + placeholder name, contact email/LinkedIn/website) and clearly-labeled placeholders where silent (reviews, >=2 blog posts, placeholder WhatsApp number, >=6 clients across the 3 SectorGroups with >=2 per bucket and some name-only). Image fields point to committed public/seed/*.png or public/brand/*.png raster paths. Pure module: no network, no secrets.

src/lib/airtable/client.ts: begin with import 'server-only'. Raw REST fetch to https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{table} with PAT bearer; token-bucket rate limiter (capacity 5, refill ~4/sec, concurrency cap 4) wrapping every call; offset pagination for lists; retry/backoff on 429/5xx (3x exponential, base 500ms); audience-split caching — public reads next:{revalidate:3600,tags:[...]}, admin reads cache:'no-store' no tags, writes cache:'no-store'. src/lib/airtable/schema.ts: table-name constants with optional AIRTABLE_TABLE_* overrides + field-name maps mirroring §5 exactly. src/lib/airtable/tags.ts: one tag per table + blogpost:{slug} + project:{slug}.

src/lib/airtable/mappers.ts: record->domain with safe defaults for every optional field (never throws, FR-24.3); image fields -> {url,alt}|null; ONE tolerant line parser for About.Points/Projects.Metrics (split newlines, trim, drop blank lines, cap ~24; Metrics split on FIRST '|' only; a line without '|' -> {value:'',label:line}). Icon keys resolved to lucide via the §5.4/§5.7 tables with a Sparkles default (mapping lives here; sections import it).

src/lib/airtable/read.ts: public reads apply Published/Visible filtering + ordering INSIDE the DAL; seed fallback when !hasAirtableCreds(); creds-present empty results -> singleton reads return seed singleton, list reads return the REAL empty set, EXCEPT getReviews() which falls back to seed placeholders on an empty live Reviews table (FR-9.2). Implement getSettings/getHero/getAbout/getCta/getNavLinks/getServices/getIndustries/getStats/getClients/getReviews/getTeam/getProjects, getProject(slug) (null unless Published===true), getProjectDetailSlugs() (hasDetail = Published && Body non-empty), getBlogPosts/getBlogPost(slug)/getPublishedPostSlugs; admin getAll* + getServiceById/getIndustryById/getStatById/getClientById/getReviewById/getTeamMemberById/getNavLinkById/getProjectById/getBlogPostById + getSubmissions.

src/lib/airtable/write.ts: create*/update*/delete* per list entity, singleton upserts (write first/only row), updateSettings, createContactSubmission (sets Status:'New' explicitly — F6), updateSubmissionStatus, and ProjectImages writers createProjectImage (Project link as an id ARRAY) / updateProjectImage / deleteProjectImage. Writers return typed results; callers own revalidation.

src/lib/**/__tests__/*.test.ts (Vitest, network-free): unit — mappers (missing/optional/malformed -> safe defaults, never throws), seed parsed against entity Zod schemas (all types present + valid), validation (bad email, over/under length, honeypot, slug normalization + uniqueness suffixing, WhatsApp digit-stripping, URL/href/image-URL rules), utils (wa.me, slugify, stat format). Integration (mocked fetch) — DAL pagination, 429->backoff->seed, 5xx->cached/seed, missing-creds->seed (no fetch), getReviews empty->seed. Airtable is never hit live.

Set FEAT-002 status to completed; in findings record the exact exported read/write function names + domain type names so FEAT-004/005 import them precisely. Commit locally inside datadive-web (never push).
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run` passes all FEAT-002 unit + integration tests.
`npm run build` passes with zero env (DAL compiles; public reads return seed when !hasAirtableCreds()).
`npm run lint` passes AND confirms client.ts/raw Airtable layer is not imported outside src/lib/airtable/**.
Seed module validates clean against every entity Zod schema with no network and no credentials.
getReviews() returns seed placeholders on an empty live Reviews table; other lists return the real empty set; singletons fall back to the seed singleton (verified by tests).
verification: cd datadive-web && npx vitest run  (all data-core tests pass)
npm run build  (zero env — must pass)
npm run lint  (passes; airtable import boundary enforced)
